column1: # test-map.tsv: path glob TAB test words (space separated): scripts/test.sh parts (golden bayan parity scripts runtime) or `<kind>/<Class>/` selectors for `bayan test tests/cases --only`. preflight.sh adds the words of every row whose glob matches a file the branch changes to the per-task test run and its wp1 parts.
# Globs are bash patterns on repo-relative paths (* also crosses /). The row for `*` is the smoke set: it always runs. Selectors name only kinds present under tests/cases.
